<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>dellamed — CRM</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  /* Paleta Dellamed 2026 */
  --navy:#002F63;--navy-light:#0D4A8A;
  --teal:#1A6BB5;--teal-light:#2E80CC;
  --gold:#A6192E;--red:#A6192E;--green:#1B7E34;--orange:#E65100;
  --brand-blue:#8BB8E8;--brand-gray:#ECEBEB;
  --bg:#F5F6FA;--card:#fff;--text:#1a1a2e;--muted:#6b7280;--border:#e0e3eb;
  --frio:#42A5F5;--morno:#FFA726;--quente:#EF5350;
  --radius:10px;--shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(10,42,78,.08);
}
html{font-size:14px}
body{font-family:'Montserrat',Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);min-height:100vh}
button{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;border:none;outline:none}
input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:.9rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;outline:none;transition:border .2s}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--teal)}
.hidden{display:none!important}

/* BTN */
.btn{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;transition:all .2s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.btn-teal{background:var(--teal);color:#fff}.btn-teal:hover{background:var(--teal-light)}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#fff}.btn-gold:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:#fff}.btn-outline:hover{border-color:#fff}
.btn-sm{padding:5px 12px;font-size:.78rem}
.btn-danger{background:var(--red);color:#fff}.btn-danger:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
.btn-green{background:var(--teal);color:#fff}

/* TOPBAR */
.topbar{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:12px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.topbar h1{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.5px;flex:1}.topbar .tb-brand{flex:1}
.topbar h1 span{color:var(--brand-blue);font-weight:400}
.topbar-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.user-badge{font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.user-badge b{color:#fff}

/* LOGIN */
.login-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#001E45 0%,#002F63 55%,#0D4A8A 100%)}
/* login-card → .login-card-hd/.login-card-bd */
.login-card h2{display:none}
/* .login-card p → .login-card-bd p */
/* .login-card input → .login-card-bd input */
/* .login-card .btn → .login-card-bd .btn */.login-notice{background:#FFF8E1;border:1px solid #FFD54F;border-radius:8px;padding:11px 14px;margin-top:14px;text-align:left;font-size:.78rem;color:#5a3e00;line-height:1.55}
.logo-text{display:none}.login-card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;max-width:430px;width:100%;box-shadow:0 24px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.38)}.login-card-hd{background:#002F63;border-top:4px solid #A6192E;padding:30px 40px 24px;text-align:center}.login-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:14px}.login-brand-name{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:lowercase;line-height:1}.login-crm-tag{display:inline-block;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(166,25,46,.6);color:#f9b9c2;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:20px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.login-card-bd{padding:30px 40px 38px;text-align:center}.login-card-bd p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:22px;font-size:.88rem}.login-card-bd input{width:100%;margin-bottom:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:.95rem}.login-card-bd .btn{width:100%;padding:13px;font-size:.95rem;margin-top:4px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}/* TOPBAR BRAND */.tb-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1}.tb-name{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-transform:lowercase;letter-spacing:.02em}.tb-crm{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--brand-blue);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;border:1px solid rgba(139,184,232,.3);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;margin-left:2px}
.login-msg{margin-top:16px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.85rem;display:none}
.login-msg.pending{display:block;background:#FFF8E1;color:#F57F17;border:1px solid #FFE082}
.login-msg.ok{display:block;background:#E8F5E9;color:#1B5E20;border:1px solid #A5D6A7}
.login-links{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px;font-size:.8rem}
.login-links a{color:#002f63;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.login-links a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.login-msg.error{display:block;background:#FFEBEE;color:#C62828;border:1px solid #EF9A9A}
.login-progress{display:none;margin-top:16px}
.login-progress.show{display:block}
.login-progress .lp-bar{width:100%;height:6px;background:#e0e3eb;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.login-progress .lp-fill{height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),#002F63);border-radius:3px;transition:width .4s ease}
.login-progress .lp-text{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}

/* PIPELINE */
.pipe-header{padding:16px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pipe-header h2{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.search-box{position:relative;flex:1;max-width:320px}
.search-box input{width:100%;padding-left:36px}
.search-box::before{content:'🔍';position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:.85rem}
.pipe-cols{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:0 24px 24px;overflow-x:auto;min-height:calc(100vh - 180px)}
.pipe-col{min-width:250px;max-width:300px;flex:1;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--radius);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.col-hdr{padding:12px 14px;font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;border-radius:var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.col-hdr .cnt{background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:.75rem}
.col-body{padding:8px;flex:1;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.card{background:var(--card);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-left:4px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(10,42,78,.12)}
.card.t-frio{border-left-color:var(--frio)}.card.t-morno{border-left-color:var(--morno)}.card.t-quente{border-left-color:var(--quente)}
.card .cn{font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.3;flex:1}
.card .ct{font-size:.65rem;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.ct.frio{background:#E3F2FD;color:#1565C0}.ct.morno{background:#FFF3E0;color:#E65100}.ct.quente{background:#FFEBEE;color:#C62828}
.card .ci{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px}
.card .tags{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.tag{font-size:.68rem;padding:2px 6px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:4px;color:var(--muted)}
.card .cf{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* MODAL */
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,42,78,.5);z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:40px 16px;overflow-y:auto}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;width:100%;max-width:780px;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25);animation:mIn .25s ease}
@keyframes mIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.mhd{padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.mhd h3{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.mx{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--muted)}
.mx:hover{background:#eee}
.mbody{padding:24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.mbody .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.mbody .frow{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.mbody .frow-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.mbody .frow-3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr}
.mbody .frow-addr{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;gap:14px;align-items:start;grid-template-columns:2.2fr 1.4fr .55fr}
/* subtítulo discreto de e-mail do vendedor, abaixo do select de Prospect */
.pr-email-sub{border:none!important;background:transparent!important;padding:2px 2px 0!important;margin-top:2px;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);cursor:default;width:100%}
.pr-email-sub:focus{outline:none}
/* Time Comercial congelado (preenchido pelo vendedor) */
.tm-frozen{background:#f0f0f0!important;cursor:not-allowed;color:var(--navy)}
@media(max-width:640px){.mbody .frow-2,.mbody .frow-3,.mbody .frow-addr{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.fld label{display:block;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:4px}
.fld input,.fld select,.fld textarea{width:100%}
.fld textarea{min-height:80px;resize:vertical}
.mft{padding:16px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px}
.fld-req label::after{content:' *';color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
.fld-err{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--red);margin-top:2px;display:none}
.fld-err.show{display:block}
.phone-row{display:flex;gap:6px}.phone-row .ph-ddd{width:72px;flex-shrink:0}.phone-row .ph-num{flex:1}
.tel3-row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tel3-col{flex:1 1 0;min-width:150px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.tel3-lbl{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0 0 4px}
.tel3-lbl.req::after{content:' *';color:var(--red)}
.canal-sug{margin-top:6px;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.4;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:7px}
.canal-sug.has-match{background:#eaf5ef;border:1px solid #a9d8bf;color:#1e5b3a}
.canal-sug.no-match{background:#f2f4f7;border:1px solid #d8dee6;color:#5a6472}
.canal-sug .cs-hint{color:inherit;opacity:.75;font-weight:400}

/* ═══ FUNIL DE VENDAS ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
/* ═══ FUNIL DE VENDAS — KANBAN ══════════════════════════════ */
.funil-fbar{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:10px 18px;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0}
.ffbar-grp{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.ffbar-lbl{font-size:.63rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.ffbar-sel,.ffbar-dt{height:32px;padding:0 9px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;background:var(--card);color:var(--text);font-size:.78rem}
.ffbar-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.ffbar-sep{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted)}
.ffbar-rst{height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;background:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;cursor:pointer;align-self:flex-end;white-space:nowrap}
.ffbar-rst:hover{border-color:#e53e3e;color:#e53e3e}
.ffbar-badge{align-self:flex-end;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:6px}
.funil-kbar{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto}
.fkpi2{flex:1;min-width:130px;padding:10px 16px;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.fkpi2:last-child{border-right:none}
.fkpi2-val{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);white-space:nowrap}
.fkpi2-lbl{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:1px}
.fkpi2-sub{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted)}
.kb-board{display:flex;flex:1 0 460px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;align-items:stretch;min-height:460px}
.kb-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:232px;flex:1;border-right:1px solid var(--border);transition:background .15s;max-width:300px}
.kb-col:last-child{border-right:none}
.kb-col.drag-over{background:rgba(0,137,123,.08)}
.kb-col-hd{padding:10px 12px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
.kb-col-title{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-bottom:5px}
.kb-col-cnt{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:10px;font-size:.67rem;font-weight:700;padding:1px 7px;margin-left:auto}
.kb-col-val{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.kb-col-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.kb-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 11px 9px;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .18s,transform .18s;position:relative;border-left:3px solid transparent}
.kb-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.13);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.kb-card.is-dragging{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.96)}
.kb-card-rs{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:3px;padding-right:22px}
.kb-card-pr{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.kb-card-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.kb-card-v{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.kb-tag{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap}
.kb-tag-hot{background:#FFF3E0;color:#E65100}
.kb-tag-warm{background:#E8F5E9;color:#2E7D32}
.kb-tag-cold{background:#E3F2FD;color:#1565C0}
.kb-tag-lost{background:#F3F4F6;color:#6B7280}
.kb-tag-inactive{background:#F3E5F5;color:#6A1B9A}
.kb-date{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px}
.kb-date-ok{background:#E8F5E9;color:#2E7D32}
.kb-date-late{background:#FFEBEE;color:#C62828}
.kb-date-soon{background:#FFF8E1;color:#B45309}
.kb-mv{position:absolute;top:8px;right:7px;background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;padding:2px 5px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;line-height:1}
.kb-card:hover .kb-mv{opacity:1}
.kb-mv:hover{background:var(--teal);color:#fff;border-color:var(--teal)}
.kb-move-dd{position:absolute;top:26px;right:0;background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.16);z-index:300;min-width:172px;padding:5px;overflow:hidden}
.kb-move-dd-title{font-size:.63rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px 2px;letter-spacing:.05em}
.kb-move-opt{padding:7px 10px;font-size:.77rem;cursor:pointer;border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.kb-move-opt:hover{background:var(--teal);color:#fff}
.kb-empty{color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem;text-align:center;padding:20px 10px;border:1.5px dashed var(--border);border-radius:8px}
.funil-zero{color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;padding:12px 0}
.funil-tbl th,.funil-tbl td{padding:9px 12px;font-size:.79rem}

/* ── ANEXOS / FILE UPLOAD ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.upload-area{border:2px dashed #c5d5e8;border-radius:8px;padding:20px;text-align:center;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;cursor:pointer;margin-top:6px}
.upload-area:hover,.upload-area.dragover{border-color:#002f63;background:rgba(0,47,99,.04)}
.upload-area-icon{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.upload-area-txt{font-size:.82rem;color:#6b7280}
.upload-area-txt b{color:#002f63}
.upload-area-limit{font-size:.68rem;color:#999;margin-top:4px}
.upload-list{margin-top:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.upload-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;background:#f8fafb;border:1px solid #e4eaf0;border-radius:7px;font-size:.8rem}
.upload-item-icon{font-size:1.1rem;flex-shrink:0}
.upload-item-name{flex:1;color:#000;font-weight:500;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.upload-item-size{font-size:.7rem;color:#999;flex-shrink:0}
.upload-item-status{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;flex-shrink:0}
.upload-item-status.ok{color:#1B7E34}
.upload-item-status.err{color:#A6192E}
.upload-item-status.uploading{color:#002f63}
.upload-item a{color:#002f63;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.upload-item a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.upload-item-rm{background:none;border:1px solid #e4eaf0;border-radius:4px;color:#999;font-size:.68rem;width:24px;height:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;padding:0}
.upload-item-rm:hover{background:#A6192E;color:#fff;border-color:#A6192E}
.upload-count{font-size:.68rem;color:#999;margin-top:4px}

/* LINK ROWS */
.link-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px}
.link-row input{flex:1;font-size:.82rem}
.btn-rm-link{background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;width:26px;height:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;padding:0}
.btn-rm-link:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)}
.btn-add-link{background:var(--bg);border:1.5px dashed var(--border);border-radius:6px;color:var(--navy);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;padding:5px 12px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s}
.btn-add-link:hover{border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal)}

/* MULTI-SELECT */
.msel{position:relative}
.msel-disp{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;min-height:38px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;align-items:center;background:#fff;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.msel-disp.active{border-color:var(--teal)}
.ms-chip{background:var(--teal);color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.ms-chip button{background:none;color:#fff;font-size:.8rem;padding:0;line-height:1}
.msel-dd{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;min-width:220px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);z-index:10;max-height:220px;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;display:none}
.msel-dd.open{display:block}
.msel-dd::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}.msel-dd::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}.msel-dd::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(10,42,78,.2);border-radius:3px}
.ms-opt{padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.82rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:background .1s}
.ms-opt:hover{background:#E0F2F1}
.ms-opt input{flex-shrink:0;width:14px;height:14px;accent-color:var(--teal);pointer-events:none;margin:0}

/* DASHBOARD */
.dash{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#F0F2F8;z-index:150;overflow-y:auto}
.dash-top{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#001E45 0%,#002F63 100%);color:#fff;padding:16px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.dash-top h2{flex:1;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700}
.dash-flt{padding:16px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:14px;align-items:start;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.dash-flt .dfg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;position:relative}
.dash-flt .dfg label{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.dash-flt select{width:100%;font-size:.8rem;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.dash-flt select:focus{border-color:var(--teal);outline:none}
.dgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(380px,1fr));gap:20px;padding:24px}
.dcard{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(10,42,78,.06);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.dcard h4{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:16px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bg)}
.dcard canvas{max-height:300px}.dcard-sub{font-size:.71rem;color:var(--muted);margin:-8px 0 10px;line-height:1.4}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px;padding:20px 24px 8px}
.leg-sec{padding:16px 24px 32px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.leg-box{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:20px 24px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(10,42,78,.06);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.leg-box h4{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:#000;margin-bottom:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.leg-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 0;font-size:.82rem;color:#000}
.leg-item b{color:#000}
.leg-dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0}
.leg-item small{color:#000;font-size:.75rem}

/* ADMIN */
.atbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.85rem}
.atbl th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 14px;text-align:left;font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1}
.atbl td{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.atbl tr:hover td{background:#f8f9ff}
.mbody[style*="max-height"]::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}
.mbody[style*="max-height"]::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#0b192b}
.mbody[style*="max-height"]::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:3px}
.mbody[style*="max-height"]::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.badge{padding:3px 10px;border-radius:10px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600}
.b-ok{background:#E0F2F1;color:#00695C}.b-pend{background:#FFF8E1;color:#F57F17}.b-rej{background:#FFEBEE;color:#C62828}.b-attr{background:#E3F2FD;color:#1565C0}

/* TOAST */
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:8px;color:#fff;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500;z-index:99999;animation:tIn .3s ease;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}

/* NOTIFICATION BELL */
.bell-wrap{position:relative;cursor:pointer}
.bell-btn{background:none;color:#fff;font-size:1.3rem;position:relative;padding:4px 8px}
.bell-badge{position:absolute;top:-2px;right:0;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px}
.admin-badge{background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;min-width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:9px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 5px;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:middle;animation:badgePulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes badgePulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.15)}}

/* THERMOMETER BAR */
.thermo-container{padding:16px 0}
.thermo-bar-wrap{position:relative;height:36px;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#e8e8e8;display:flex}
.thermo-seg{height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;transition:width .6s ease;min-width:0}
.thermo-seg span{text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);white-space:nowrap}
.thermo-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:10px}
.thermo-lbl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.82rem}
.thermo-lbl .td{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0}
.thermo-lbl b{font-size:1.15rem;color:#000}
.thermo-lbl small{color:#000;font-size:.72rem}
.thermo-indicator{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.thermo-score{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.thermo-score-lbl{font-size:.78rem;color:#000;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn-loading{opacity:.7;pointer-events:none;position:relative}
.btn-loading::after{content:'';display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .5s linear infinite;margin-left:8px;vertical-align:middle}
.bell-dd{position:absolute;top:100%;right:0;width:320px;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18);z-index:20;max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;display:none}
.bell-dd.open{display:block}
.bell-item{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text)}
.bell-item b{color:var(--navy)}
.bell-item small{color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem}
.bell-empty{padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem}

/* THERMOMETER */
.thermo-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:8px 0}
.thermo{position:relative;width:48px;height:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;border-radius:24px 24px 50% 50%;background:#F5F6FA;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.thermo-fill{width:100%;transition:height .6s ease;border-radius:0 0 50% 50%}
.thermo-bulb{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;position:absolute;bottom:-8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem;color:#fff;z-index:2}
.thermo-labels{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;flex:1}
.thermo-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.thermo-dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
.thermo-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.thermo-info b{font-size:1.1rem;color:#000}
.thermo-info small{font-size:.72rem;color:#000}
.thermo-pct{font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:800;min-width:50px;text-align:right}
.toast.ok{background:var(--green)}.toast.err{background:var(--red)}
@keyframes tIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* KPI INTERACTIVE */
.kpi{background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:20px 16px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.04);border:1px solid #e0e0e0;transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(10,42,78,.1)}
.kpi.kpi-active{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,137,123,.2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.kpi .kv{font-size:2.25rem;font-weight:700;color:#0F3C6E;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-0.06em;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
.kpi .kl{font-size:.75rem;color:#666;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:6px;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:600;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}

/* TABS */
.tabs{display:flex;gap:0;padding:0 24px;background:#fff;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border)}
.tab{padding:12px 24px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;transition:all .2s;user-select:none}
.tab:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.tab.active{color:var(--navy);border-bottom-color:var(--teal)}

/* MAIN FILTERS */
.main-flt{padding:16px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:14px;align-items:start;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.main-flt .fg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;position:relative}
.main-flt .fg label{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.main-flt select,.main-flt input[type="date"]{font-size:.82rem;padding:7px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;width:100%}
/* Searchable filter dropdown */
.sf-wrap{position:relative;min-width:160px;width:100%}
.sf-input{width:100%;padding:7px 28px 7px 10px;font-size:.82rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;outline:none;background:#fff}
.sf-input:focus{border-color:var(--teal)}
.sf-dd{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;min-width:200px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.12);max-height:220px;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;z-index:20;display:none}
.sf-dd.open{display:block}
.sf-dd::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}.sf-dd::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}.sf-dd::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(10,42,78,.2);border-radius:3px}
.sf-opt{padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.82rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:background .1s;white-space:nowrap}
.sf-opt:hover,.sf-opt.hl{background:#E0F2F1}
.sf-opt.sel{background:var(--teal);color:#fff}
.sf-opt input[type="checkbox"]{flex-shrink:0;width:14px;height:14px;accent-color:var(--teal);pointer-events:none;margin:0}
.sf-clear{position:absolute;right:6px;top:8px;background:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem;padding:0 4px;cursor:pointer;display:none}
.sf-clear.show{display:block}
.sf-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;margin-bottom:4px}
.sf-chips .ms-chip{font-size:.68rem;padding:1px 6px}
.st-pills{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:stretch}
.st-pill{min-width:100px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius);cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:all .2s;user-select:none;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.st-pill .sp-val{font-size:2.25rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-0.06em;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
.st-pill .sp-lbl{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;opacity:1;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
.st-pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(10,42,78,.12)}
.st-pill.active{border-color:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(10,42,78,.15)}

/* LEADS TABLE */
.leads-tbl-wrap{padding:0 24px 16px;overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 225px)}
.leads-tbl-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;height:6px}
.leads-tbl-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#f0f0f0;border-radius:3px}
.leads-tbl-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(10,42,78,.25);border-radius:3px}
.leads-tbl-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:rgba(10,42,78,.4)}
.leads-tbl-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:rgba(10,42,78,.4)}
.leads-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;font-size:.82rem;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.leads-tbl th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:8px 14px;text-align:left;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.25;vertical-align:middle;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:background .15s}
.leads-tbl th:hover{background:var(--navy-light)}
.sort-arrow{display:inline-block;margin-left:4px;font-size:.6rem;opacity:.4;transition:opacity .15s}
.sort-arrow.asc::after{content:'▲';opacity:1}
.sort-arrow.desc::after{content:'▼';opacity:1}
.sort-arrow:not(.asc):not(.desc)::after{content:'⇅';font-size:.7rem}
.leads-tbl td{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;vertical-align:middle;white-space:nowrap;max-width:220px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;line-height:1.5;font-size:.875rem;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;color:#404040}
.leads-tbl tbody tr{display:table-row;transition:background .1s;cursor:pointer}
.leads-tbl tbody tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#FAFBFD}
.leads-tbl tbody tr:hover td{background:#EDF2FF}
.temp-badge{padding:4px 12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;display:inline-block;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
.tb-frio{background:#e3f2fd;color:#0F3C6E}.tb-morno{background:#fff3cd;color:#7d5a00}.tb-quente{background:#fce4ec;color:#880e4f}.tb-inativo{background:#f5f5f5;color:#616161}.tb-perdido{background:#f5f5f5;color:#9e9e9e}
.st-badge{padding:4px 12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;display:inline-block;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
.temp-badge{padding:4px 12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
.tbl-count{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 24px}
.loader{display:inline-block;width:36px;height:36px;border:3px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);border-top-color:var(--teal);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .6s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.loading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:60vh;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;color:var(--muted)}

/* STATUS COLORS */
.s-novo{background:#e3f2fd;color:#0F3C6E}
.s-contato{background:#e0f2f1;color:#00695c}
.s-proposta{background:#e1f5fe;color:#01579b}
.s-negociando{background:#fff3cd;color:#7d5a00}
.s-ganho{background:#c8e6c9;color:#1b5e20}
.s-perdido{background:#ffcdd2;color:#b71c1c}
.s-inativo{background:#f5f5f5;color:#616161}

@media(max-width:768px){
  .pipe-cols{padding:0 12px 12px}.pipe-col{min-width:220px}
  .mbody{grid-template-columns:1fr}.dgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .leg-sec{grid-template-columns:1fr}.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .topbar{padding:10px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
}


/* ============================================================
   DELLAMED CRM — DARK MODERN UI (visual layer only)
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --d-bg:#07111f;--d-bg2:#0a1627;--d-panel:#0d1b2e;--d-panel2:#10223a;
  --d-line:#223651;--d-line2:#2d4565;--d-text:#edf5ff;--d-muted:#91a5c1;
  --d-cyan:#8BB8E8;--d-cyan2:#A8CCF0;--d-green:#34d399;--d-red:#fb7185;
  --d-orange:#fbbf24;--d-purple:#a78bfa;--d-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}
html,body{background:var(--d-bg)!important;color:var(--d-text)!important}
body{background:
  radial-gradient(1000px 520px at 8% -5%,rgba(34,211,238,.08),transparent 56%),
  radial-gradient(900px 500px at 100% 0%,rgba(99,102,241,.08),transparent 52%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,#07111f,#091523 55%,#07111f)!important;background-attachment:fixed!important}
*{scrollbar-color:#2a415f transparent}
*::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px}*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#2a415f;border-radius:20px}

.dash{background:
  radial-gradient(900px 480px at 0% 0%,rgba(34,211,238,.07),transparent 60%),
  radial-gradient(900px 500px at 100% 0%,rgba(99,102,241,.07),transparent 55%),
  #07111f!important;color:var(--d-text)}
.dash-top{background:rgba(7,17,31,.92)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,211,252,.14);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.26)!important;padding:15px 26px}.dash-top h2{font-size:1.22rem;letter-spacing:-.25px;color:#fff!important}

/* Pie labels */
.pie-note{font-size:.72rem;color:#8297b4;margin-top:8px;text-align:center}

/* Modern thermometer — light theme */
.thermo-modern{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:26px;align-items:center;min-height:300px;padding:8px 8px 4px}
.tm-visual{height:260px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.tm-tube{position:relative;width:42px;height:205px;border:2px solid #bbb;border-radius:24px 24px 18px 18px;background:#f0f0f0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);overflow:hidden;padding:5px}.tm-liquid{position:absolute;left:5px;right:5px;bottom:5px;border-radius:16px;transition:height .55s ease;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#1A6BB5 0%,#3B82C4 28%,#E65100 62%,#A6192E 100%);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,47,99,.15)}.tm-glass{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent 45%,rgba(255,255,255,.04));pointer-events:none}.tm-bulb{position:absolute;width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,22%);background:#f0f0f0;border:2px solid #bbb;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.tm-bulb::after{content:'';width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tm-color);box-shadow:0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-color) 35%,transparent)}.tm-score{position:absolute;top:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-weight:800;font-size:1.55rem;color:#000;white-space:nowrap}.tm-score small{display:block;text-align:center;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:#444;margin-top:2px}.tm-marks{position:absolute;right:1px;top:30px;bottom:42px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;color:#444;font-size:.62rem}.tm-marks span::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:10px;height:1px;background:#bbb;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle}.tm-summary{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.tm-state{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid #dce8f2;padding-bottom:12px}.tm-state .name{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:800;color:#000}.tm-state .desc{font-size:.72rem;color:#333}.tm-stat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8f2;border-radius:10px}.tm-stat .lab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#000;font-size:.8rem}.tm-stat .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%}.tm-stat .val{font-size:1rem;font-weight:800;color:#000}.tm-stat .val small{font-size:.66rem;color:#444;font-weight:500;margin-left:4px}

/* Brazil map — FULL DEFINITION */
.br-map-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(180px,.6fr);gap:18px;align-items:stretch;min-height:360px}
.br-map-canvas{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:360px;background:#f5f7fb;border:1px solid #dce8f2;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden}
.br-map-canvas svg{width:100%;height:355px;max-width:590px;overflow:visible}
.br-map-canvas path{transition:fill .2s ease,filter .2s ease;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.br-map-canvas path:hover{filter:brightness(1.15);stroke:#002f63!important;stroke-width:1.35!important}
.br-map-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.br-map-section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8f2;border-radius:12px;padding:12px}
.br-map-section h5{font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:#000;margin-bottom:8px}
.br-region-row,.br-uf-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:5px 0;color:#000;font-size:.75rem}
.br-region-row b,.br-uf-row b{color:#000}

<style id="dellamed-fixes">
/* ═══ FIXES VISUAIS FINAIS ════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── GRID DO DASHBOARD ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* L1: 3 cards | L2: 2 cards | L3: 2 cards | resto: full width */
html body .dgrid{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)!important;
  gap:18px!important;
  padding:20px 24px!important;
}
html body .dcard{min-width:0!important}
/* Linha 1: 3 cards (cada ocupa 2 de 6 colunas) */
html body .dcard.dcard-r1{grid-column:span 2!important}
/* Linha 2: 3 cards (Por Time, Por Linha, Por Porte) — cada um ocupa 2 de 6 colunas */
html body .dcard.dcard-r2{grid-column:span 2!important}
/* Linha 3: UF (mapa largo) + Motivos da Perda */
html body .dcard.dcard-r3{grid-column:span 3!important;min-height:380px!important}
html body .dcard.dcard-map.dcard-r3{grid-column:span 4!important;min-height:450px!important}
html body .dcard.dcard-r3:not(.dcard-map){grid-column:span 2!important}
/* Wide: full width */
html body .dcard.dcard-wide{grid-column:1/-1!important}

@media(max-width:1100px){
  html body .dgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)!important}
  html body .dcard.dcard-r1,html body .dcard.dcard-r2,html body .dcard.dcard-r3{grid-column:span 1!important}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  html body .dgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  html body .dcard.dcard-r1,html body .dcard.dcard-r2,html body .dcard.dcard-r3,html body .dcard.dcard-wide{grid-column:1!important}
}

<style id="login-recuperar-link-garantido">

   Quando o modo ENTRAR está visível, este link não pode ser escondido. */

  display:inline-block!important;
  visibility:visible!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
/* Cor legível no card escuro (o card é #002f63; a cor original dos links
   também era #002f63, o que os deixava invisíveis). */

<body>

<!-- LOGIN -->
<div id="scLogin" class="login-wrap">
  <div class="login-card">
    <!-- Cabeçalho de marca -->
    <div class="login-card-hd">
      <img class="login-hero-banner" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="I'M CRM Power Sales Engineering">
      <div class="login-crm-subtitle">CRM</div>
    </div>
    <!-- Corpo do formulário -->
    <div class="login-card-bd">
      <div id="lmEntrar">
        <p>Entre com seu e-mail e senha</p>
        <input type="email" id="inEmail" placeholder="seu.email@dellamed.com.br" autocomplete="username">
        <input type="password" id="inSenha" placeholder="Senha" autocomplete="current-password">
        <button class="btn btn-teal" id="btnLogin" style="font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif">ENTRAR</button>
        <div class="login-links">
          <a href="#" data-login-link="codigo" onclick="return _loginModo('codigo')">Primeiro acesso ou esqueci a senha</a>
          <a href="#" onclick="return _loginModo('solicitar')">Solicitar acesso</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="lmCodigo" class="hidden">
        <p>Vamos enviar um código de 6 dígitos para o seu e-mail corporativo.</p>
        <input type="email" id="cdEmail" placeholder="seu.email@dellamed.com.br" autocomplete="username">
        <button class="btn btn-teal" id="btnEnviarCodigo" style="font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif">ENVIAR CÓDIGO</button>
        <div id="cdEtapa2" class="hidden" style="margin-top:14px">
          <input type="text" id="cdCodigo" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="6" autocomplete="one-time-code" placeholder="Código de 6 dígitos">
          <input type="password" id="cdSenha" placeholder="Nova senha (mínimo 8 caracteres)" autocomplete="new-password">
          <input type="password" id="cdSenha2" placeholder="Repita a nova senha" autocomplete="new-password">
          <button class="btn btn-teal" id="btnCriarSenha" style="font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif">SALVAR SENHA</button>
        </div>
        <div class="login-links"><a href="#" onclick="return _loginModo('entrar')">Voltar para o login</a></div>
      </div>
      <div id="lmSolicitar" class="hidden">
        <p>Use o nome e sobrenome exatos do cadastro corporativo.</p>
        <input type="text" id="inNome" placeholder="Nome e Sobrenome" autocomplete="name">
        <input type="email" id="slEmail" placeholder="seu.email@dellamed.com.br" autocomplete="email">
        <button class="btn btn-teal" id="btnSolicitar" style="font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif">SOLICITAR ACESSO</button>
        <div class="login-links"><a href="#" onclick="return _loginModo('entrar')">Voltar para o login</a></div>
      </div>
      <div class="login-progress" id="loginProgress">
        <div class="lp-bar"><div class="lp-fill" id="lpFill"></div></div>
        <div class="lp-text" id="lpText">Conectando...</div>
      </div>
      <div id="loginMsg" class="login-msg"></div>
    </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>


<style id="crm-sidebar">
:root{--topbar-h:64px;--sidenav-w:266px}
html body .app-shell{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;width:100%}

html body .side-nav{flex:0 0 var(--sidenav-w);width:var(--sidenav-w);position:sticky;top:var(--topbar-h);align-self:flex-start;height:calc(100vh - var(--topbar-h));overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;background:#f0f4f9!important;border-right:2px solid #c5d5e8;padding:16px 16px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;z-index:40}
html body .side-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
html body .side-nav::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#c5d5e8;border-radius:20px}
html body .side-menu-lbl,html body .side-sec-lbl{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:.70rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#0F3C6E;padding:0 2px 8px;margin:0}
html body .side-menu{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
html body .side-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px 13px;border-radius:7px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #c5d5e8;color:#0F3C6E;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;line-height:1.2}
html body .side-item .si-ic{font-size:1rem;flex:0 0 auto;width:20px;text-align:center}
html body .side-item:hover{border-color:#002f63;background:#eaf1fb}
html body .side-item.active{background:#002f63;border-color:#002f63;color:#fff;font-weight:700;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #A6192E,0 2px 8px rgba(0,47,99,.2)}
html body .side-sec{border-top:1px solid #c5d5e8;padding-top:16px}
html body .side-nav .main-flt{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:0!important;background:none!important;border:none!important;box-shadow:none!important}
html body .side-nav .main-flt .fg{width:100%}
html body .side-nav .main-flt label{color:#0F3C6E!important;font-size:.68rem!important;font-weight:600!important;letter-spacing:.05em!important}
html body .side-nav .main-flt select,html body .side-nav .main-flt .sf-input,html body .side-nav .main-flt input[type="date"]{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;background:#fff!important;border:1.5px solid #c5d5e8!important;color:#002f63!important;border-radius:7px!important;height:36px!important}
html body .side-nav .main-flt .btn-sm{width:100%!important;background:#A6192E!important;border:none!important;color:#fff!important;height:36px!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-weight:700!important}
/* Busca no topo da lateral — mesmo visual dos campos de filtro */
html body .side-sec-first{border-top:none;padding-top:0}
html body .side-search{max-width:none;flex:none;width:100%}
html body .side-search input{width:100%!important;padding-left:34px!important;background:#fff!important;border:1.5px solid #c5d5e8!important;color:#002f63!important;border-radius:7px!important;height:36px!important;font-size:.8rem!important}
html body .side-search input::placeholder{color:#8babc9!important}
html body .side-search input:focus{border-color:#002f63!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,47,99,.1)!important}
html body .side-search::before{content:'\1F50D';position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:.85rem;z-index:1}
/* pipe-header (agora sem a busca) fica oculto para a lateral alinhar com os KPIs */
html body .app-main .pipe-header{display:none!important}
html body #funilFbar{display:none!important}
html body .kpi-legend{margin:14px 24px 26px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid #d0dce8;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,47,99,.07)}
html body .kpi-legend>summary.kpi-legend-hd{font-size:.70rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#002f63;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;list-style:none;outline:none}
html body .kpi-legend>summary.kpi-legend-hd::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
html body .kpi-legend>summary.kpi-legend-hd::before{content:'▸';font-size:.72rem;line-height:1;color:#A6192E;transition:transform .15s;display:inline-block}
html body .kpi-legend[open]>summary.kpi-legend-hd{margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4eaf0}
html body .kpi-legend[open]>summary.kpi-legend-hd::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
html body .kpi-legend-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:8px 24px}
html body .kpi-legend-grid span{font-size:.76rem;color:#666;line-height:1.5;font-weight:400}
html body .kpi-legend-grid b{color:#0F3C6E;font-weight:600}
html body .side-nav .kpi-legend{margin:12px 0 0;padding:10px 12px}
html body .side-nav .kpi-legend-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:7px}
html body .side-nav .kpi-legend-grid span{font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.5;font-weight:400}
html body .dfg-period .df-period-val{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:#002f63;padding:7px 10px;background:#eef3fb;border:1.5px solid #c5d5e8;border-radius:7px;white-space:nowrap;height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center}
html body .app-main #funilView{height:auto;min-height:calc(100vh - var(--topbar-h) - 96px);padding:0 24px 14px}
@media(max-width:1024px){

  html body .side-nav .side-menu{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap}
  html body .side-item{flex:1 1 160px}

  html body .side-nav .main-flt .fg{flex:1 1 180px;width:auto}
}
</style>
<style id="crm-redesign-2026">
/* ===== VISIBILIDADE DE COLUNAS (apenas Nº, Data, Data Próx. Ação, Próx. Ação, Status, Temperatura, Prospect) ===== */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(n+10),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(n+10){display:none!important}
/* Divisória vertical MUITO suave entre as colunas visíveis (1 a 8; a 9 não recebe para não criar linha na borda) */
.leads-tbl td:nth-child(-n+8){border-right:1px solid rgba(0,47,99,.055)!important}
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(-n+8){border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important}
/* Data(2): aproximar do Status (reduz espaço lateral) */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(2),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(2){padding-right:3px}
/* Status(3): encostado na Data */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(3),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(3){max-width:112px;width:112px;padding-left:5px}
/* Canal Principal(5) */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(5),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(5){max-width:130px;width:130px}
/* Temperatura(6) */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(6),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(6){max-width:104px;width:104px}
/* Data Próxima Ação(7): cabeçalho SEMPRE em 2 linhas (Data / Próxima Ação), sem reflow no zoom */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(7),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(7){max-width:110px;width:110px;padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px;white-space:nowrap}
/* Próxima Ação(8): maior */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(8),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(8){max-width:300px;width:300px}
/* Prospect(9): menor */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(9),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(9){max-width:122px;width:122px}

/* ===== AJUSTE: PROSPECT e CANAL PRINCIPAL sempre com NOME INTEIRO (sem corte em qualquer zoom) ===== */
/* Nº(1): compacto */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(1),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(1){max-width:56px!important;width:56px!important;padding-left:8px!important;padding-right:6px!important}
/* Data(2): compacta, sem quebra */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(2),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(2){max-width:82px!important;width:82px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;padding-left:6px!important;padding-right:6px!important}
/* Razão Social(4): reduzida; nome trunca com reticências (completo no tooltip), UF sempre visível */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(4),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(4){max-width:172px!important;width:172px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden!important}
.leads-tbl td:nth-child(4) .rs-cell{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;width:100%;max-width:100%}
.leads-tbl td:nth-child(4) .rs-name{flex:1 1 0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.leads-tbl td:nth-child(4) .rs-uf{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;color:#3d5a80;background:#e8eef6;border:1px solid #d3ddec;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;letter-spacing:.3px}
.leads-tbl td:nth-child(4) .rs-exp{color:#7a4d00;background:#fff3d6;border-color:#f0c36d;font-size:.72rem;padding:1px 4px}
.rs-porte{display:inline-block;flex:0 0 auto;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;letter-spacing:.3px;color:#4b3b73!important;background:#efeafc!important;border:1px solid #d6cbef!important}
.leads-tbl td:nth-child(5) .rs-cell{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;width:100%;max-width:100%}
.leads-tbl td:nth-child(5) .rs-name{flex:1 1 0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.lp-editrow .lp-eye{margin-left:6px;padding:6px 10px}
/* Canal Principal(5): nome inteiro sempre — quebra de linha, nunca corta */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(5),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(5){max-width:172px!important;width:172px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden!important}
/* Prospect(9): nome inteiro sempre — quebra de linha, nunca corta */
.leads-tbl th:nth-child(9),.leads-tbl td:nth-child(9){max-width:none!important;width:160px!important;white-space:normal!important;overflow:visible!important;text-overflow:clip!important;word-break:break-word!important;line-height:1.3}

/* ===== AVISO DE CNPJ DUPLICADO ===== */
.cnpj-dup-warn{margin-top:7px;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:8px;background:#fff7e6;border:1px solid #f0c36d;color:#7a4d00;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.45}
.cnpj-dup-warn .cdw-item{display:block;margin-top:2px}
.cnpj-dup-warn .cdw-pr{color:#9a6b00;font-weight:600}

/* ===== TOGGLE OLHINHO (ocultar lead) ===== */
.eye-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-family:inherit;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;width:100%;text-align:left}
.eye-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--teal)}
.eye-toggle .eye-ic{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1}
.eye-toggle.is-oculto{background:#fdecef;border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}
.qf-chip-oculto{border-color:#6B7280;color:#374151}
.qf-chip-oculto.active{background:#374151!important;border-color:#374151!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(55,65,81,.25)!important}

/* ===== FILTROS RÁPIDOS ===== */
.qf-bar{padding:2px 24px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qf-bar .qf-lbl{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-right:2px}
#qfChips,#ffQuick{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qf-chip{padding:6px 13px;border-radius:20px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap;font-family:inherit}
.qf-chip:hover{border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal)}
.qf-chip.active{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,47,99,.25)}
.ff-quick-grp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ff-quick-grp .ffbar-lbl{white-space:nowrap}

/* ===== PAINEL LATERAL DO LEAD ===== */
.lp-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,42,78,.42);z-index:180;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s}
.lp-backdrop.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.lead-panel{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100vh;width:min(560px,94vw);background:#fff;z-index:190;box-shadow:-8px 0 40px rgba(10,42,78,.25);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.lead-panel.open{transform:none}
.lp-head{padding:18px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7f9fc,#fff)}
.lp-title{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.25}
.lp-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.lp-badges{margin-top:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lp-temp{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-weight:600}
.lp-x{width:34px;height:34px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--muted);border:none;cursor:pointer}
.lp-x:hover{background:#e7ebf3;color:var(--navy)}
.pnl-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 14px;background:#fff;flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto}
.pnl-tab{padding:11px 15px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .15s;user-select:none}
.pnl-tab:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.pnl-tab.active{color:var(--teal);border-bottom-color:var(--teal)}
.pnl-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
.lead-panel .panel-content{padding:20px 22px}
.pnl-sec{margin-bottom:22px}
.pnl-sec-t{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:11px}
.lead-panel .info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:13px}
.lead-panel .info-item label{display:block;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px}
.lead-panel .info-item span{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;word-break:break-word}
.lp-editrow{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:14px}
.pnl-more{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;cursor:pointer}
.lp-empty{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);padding:14px 0}
.tl-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.lp-locked{width:100%;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#f2f4f7;border:1px solid #d8dee6;color:#4a5568;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.45;margin-bottom:8px}
.lp-lig{background:#f7f9fc;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.lp-lig-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
.lp-lig-filter{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lp-lig-filter select{padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-family:inherit;font-size:.82rem;background:#fff;color:var(--text)}
.ped-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-size:.85rem}
.ped-row:first-child{border-top:none}
.ped-del{background:none;border:none;color:var(--red);cursor:pointer;font-size:.9rem;padding:2px 6px}
.tl-btn{padding:7px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:#fff;border-radius:7px;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;color:var(--navy);font-family:inherit;transition:all .15s}
.tl-btn:hover{border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal)}
.tl-wrap{position:relative;padding-left:24px}
.tl-wrap::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:7px;top:6px;bottom:4px;width:2px;background:var(--border)}
.tl-item{position:relative;margin-bottom:18px}
.tl-dot{position:absolute;left:-24px;top:3px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff}
.dot-call{background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--teal)}
.dot-email{background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--green)}
.dot-note{background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--gold)}
.dot-status{background:#8B6FA6;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #8B6FA6}
.dot-proposal{background:var(--navy-light);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--navy-light)}
.dot-task{background:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--orange)}
.dot-contact{background:#1A6BB5;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #1A6BB5}
.dot-created{background:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--navy)}
.tl-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:4px}
.tl-type{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.tl-date{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted)}
.tl-author{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto}
.tl-body{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.5;background:var(--bg);padding:9px 12px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.lp-next{border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.lp-next.lp-late{background:#FDECEA;border-color:var(--red)}
.lp-next.lp-soon{background:#FFF7E6;border-color:var(--orange)}
.lp-next.lp-ok{background:#EAF3FB;border-color:var(--teal)}
.lp-next-lbl{font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--navy)}
.lp-next-body{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text);margin-top:4px}
.lp-next-date{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.lp-next-mail{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--teal);margin-top:6px;font-weight:600}
.lp-files{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.lp-file{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 11px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text)}
.lp-file:hover{border-color:var(--teal)}
.lp-file-n{flex:1;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.lp-file-o{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--teal);font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:560px){.lead-panel .info-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* ===== FUNIL INLINE (aba fixa) ===== */
#funilView{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:calc(100vh - 210px);min-height:520px;padding:0 24px 14px}
.funil-inline-head{font-size:1.02rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);padding:12px 2px 10px}
/* ===== COMPOSER DE ATIVIDADES ===== */
#lpComposer{background:#f7f9fc;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.cmp-head{font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.cmp-note{margin-top:8px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}
.cmp-note-warn{margin-top:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:#fff7e6;border:1px solid #f0c36d;color:#7a4d00}
.cmp-row{display:flex;gap:10px}
.cmp-fg{flex:1;margin-bottom:8px}
.cmp-fg label,.cmp-l{display:block;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0 0 4px}
#lpComposer input,#lpComposer textarea,#lpComposer select{width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;font-family:inherit;font-size:.85rem;box-sizing:border-box;background:#fff;color:var(--text)}
#lpComposer textarea{resize:vertical}
.cmp-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
/* Semáforo por LINHA inteira (vence o striping !important) */
html body .leads-tbl tbody tr.row-due-late td{background:#F8D0D5!important}
html body .leads-tbl tbody tr.row-due-today td{background:#FFEFB0!important}
html body .leads-tbl tbody tr.row-due-late:hover td{background:#F3BFC5!important}
html body .leads-tbl tbody tr.row-due-today:hover td{background:#FBE79A!important}
html body .leads-tbl tbody tr.row-due-late td:nth-child(7){font-weight:700!important;color:#A6192E!important}
html body .leads-tbl tbody tr.row-due-today td:nth-child(7){font-weight:700!important;color:#7A5B00!important}
/* Ações em massa */
.bulk-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 24px 10px;padding:10px 14px;background:#eef4fb;border:1px solid #cfe0f2;border-radius:10px}
.bulk-bar.hidden{display:none!important}
.bulk-count{font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:.85rem}
.bulk-grp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.bulk-grp label{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.bulk-grp select{padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-family:inherit;font-size:.82rem;background:#fff;color:var(--text)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border:none}
