  border-radius: 4px !important;
  font-size: .75rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: .03em !important;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif !important;
  display: inline-block !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}
html body .st-badge {
  padding: 4px 12px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  font-size: .75rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: .03em !important;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif !important;
  color: inherit !important;
}

/* St-badge na tabela: respeitar cor inline */
html body .leads-tbl td .st-badge { color: inherit !important; }

/* Cores neutras pastéis — estilo amostragem */
html body .tb-frio { background: #e3f2fd !important; color: #0F3C6E !important; }
html body .tb-morno { background: #fff3cd !important; color: #7d5a00 !important; }
html body .tb-quente { background: #fce4ec !important; color: #880e4f !important; }
html body .tb-inativo { background: #f5f5f5 !important; color: #616161 !important; }
html body .tb-perdido { background: #f5f5f5 !important; color: #9e9e9e !important; }

html body .b-ok { background: #c8e6c9 !important; color: #1b5e20 !important; }
html body .b-pend { background: #fff3cd !important; color: #7d5a00 !important; }
html body .b-rej { background: #ffcdd2 !important; color: #b71c1c !important; }
html body .b-attr { background: #e3f2fd !important; color: #0F3C6E !important; }

/* Temp-badge na tabela: cor própria, não branca */
html body .leads-tbl td .temp-badge { color: inherit !important; }

/* Kanban tags neutras */
html body .kb-tag-hot { background: #fce4ec !important; color: #880e4f !important; }
html body .kb-tag-warm { background: #e3f2fd !important; color: #0F3C6E !important; }
html body .kb-tag-cold { background: #e0f7fa !important; color: #006064 !important; }
html body .kb-tag-lost { background: #f5f5f5 !important; color: #616161 !important; }
html body .kb-tag-inactive { background: #f3e5f5 !important; color: #6a1b9a !important; }

html body .leads-tbl td .kb-tag-hot { color: #880e4f !important; }
html body .leads-tbl td .kb-tag-warm { color: #0F3C6E !important; }
html body .leads-tbl td .kb-tag-cold { color: #006064 !important; }
html body .leads-tbl td .kb-tag-lost { color: #616161 !important; }
html body .leads-tbl td .kb-tag-inactive { color: #6a1b9a !important; }

/* Scrollbar clean */
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f0f0f0 !important; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #999 !important; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #666 !important; }
</style>
<style id="fpan-styles">
/* ===== Panorama do Funil (acima do kanban) ===== */
html body .funil-panorama{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,.85fr) 1.15fr;
  gap:22px; align-items:start;
  background:#fff; border:1px solid #e0e3eb; border-radius:12px;
  padding:14px 18px; margin:8px 0 10px; flex-shrink:0;
}
.fpan-title{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:10px}
.fpan-left{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.fpan-funnel{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center}
.fpan-funnel svg{flex-shrink:0;width:220px;height:auto}
.fpan-leg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0}
.fpan-leg-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.77rem}
.fpan-dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;flex-shrink:0}
.fpan-dot.rnd{border-radius:50%;width:9px;height:9px}
.fpan-leg-name{font-weight:600;color:#1a1a2e;flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.fpan-leg-cnt{font-weight:700;color:#0F3C6E;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fpan-leg-pct{color:#6b7280;font-size:.71rem;width:46px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fpan-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
html body .fpan-kpigrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border:1px solid #e0e3eb;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
html body .fpan-kpigrid .fkpi2{flex:none !important;min-width:0 !important;padding:12px 15px !important;
  border-right:1px solid #e0e3eb !important;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e3eb !important;background:#fff !important}
html body .fpan-kpigrid .fkpi2:nth-child(3n){border-right:none !important}
html body .fpan-kpigrid .fkpi2:nth-child(n+4){border-bottom:none !important}
@media(max-width:900px){
  html body .funil-panorama{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .fpan-funnel{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .fpan-funnel svg{width:190px;margin:0 auto}
}
</style>
<style id='login-image-full-frame'>
html body .login-card-hd{padding:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;}
html body .login-brand{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;display:block!important;}
html body .login-brand > svg, html body .login-brand-name{display:none!important;}
html body .login-crm-tag{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;display:block!important;object-fit:cover!important;}
@media(max-width:768px){html body .login-crm-tag{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;}}
</style>
<style data-app media="not all">
:root{
  --navy:#0F3C6E;--navy2:#174a85;--navy3:#0a2d54;--cyan:#36B0C9;--teal:#3BBFAD;--coral:#EA6852;
  --ink:#1b2a3d;--mute:#667487;--line:#dfe5ee;--bg:#f3f5f9;--card:#fff;--ro:#f2f4f8;
  --frio:#4FC3F7;--morno:#FBC02D;--quente:#E53935;
  --shell:52px;--side:252px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0}
body{font-family:Montserrat,system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-size:13px}
button{font-family:inherit}
.hidden{display:none!important}
/* ===== SHELL BAR (padrão SAP) ===== */
.shell{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;height:var(--shell);background:var(--navy);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 16px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06),0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.sh-menu{background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;padding:6px;border-radius:6px}
.sh-menu:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.sh-logo{height:26px;display:block}
.sh-search{flex:1;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.sh-search .box{width:min(560px,100%);position:relative}
.sh-search input{width:100%;height:32px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;padding:0 14px 0 36px;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px}
.sh-search input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.sh-search input:focus{outline:none;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.sh-search input:focus::placeholder{color:#8a97a8}
.sh-search .ic{position:absolute;left:12px;top:7px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:13px;pointer-events:none}
.sh-search input:focus+.ic{color:var(--mute)}
.sh-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.sh-btn{position:relative;height:32px;min-width:32px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:8px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.sh-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.sh-btn.pri{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;padding:0 14px}
.sh-btn.pri:hover{background:#e9f3fb}
.sh-badge{position:absolute;top:1px;right:1px;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--coral);color:#fff;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px}
.sh-user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 6px 0 10px;height:34px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);margin-left:4px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.sh-av{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:11px}
.sh-un{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15}
.sh-un b{font-size:12px}.sh-un small{font-size:10px;opacity:.75}
.dd{position:absolute;top:44px;right:0;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(10,30,60,.2);min-width:260px;z-index:80;overflow:hidden;display:none}
.dd.on{display:block}
.dd-h{padding:10px 14px;font-weight:700;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.dd-h button{border:0;background:none;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px}
.dd-i{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f6;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;cursor:default}
.dd-i small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:10.5px;margin-top:2px}
.dd-i.unread{background:#f2f9fc}
.dd-empty{padding:18px 14px;color:var(--mute);font-size:12px;text-align:center}
.dd-a{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;border:0;background:none;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.dd-a:hover{background:#f3f7fb}
/* ===== LAYOUT ===== */
.app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--side) 1fr;min-height:calc(100vh - var(--shell))}
.app.collapsed{grid-template-columns:0 1fr}
.app.collapsed .side{display:none}
.side{background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 12px 30px;position:sticky;top:var(--shell);height:calc(100vh - var(--shell));overflow:auto}
.side h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
.nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-bottom:18px}
.nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;color:#34465d;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;position:relative}
.nav a .ni{width:18px;text-align:center}
.nav a:hover{background:#eef3f9}
.nav a.on{background:#e6f2fa;color:var(--navy)}
.nav a.on:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-12px;top:6px;bottom:6px;width:4px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;background:var(--cyan)}
.nav a .cnt{margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:10px;padding:1px 7px;color:var(--mute)}
.flt{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:14px}
.fg{margin-bottom:11px}
.fg>label{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#3b4b60;margin-bottom:4px}
.fg select,.fg input[type=date]{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 8px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.drow{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}.drow input{min-width:0}
.btn-clear{width:100%;background:var(--coral);color:#fff;border:0;font-weight:700;padding:9px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px}
.btn-clear:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}
/* multi-select */
.ms{position:relative}
.ms-box{min-height:34px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:4px 26px 4px 6px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;background:#fff}
.ms-box .ph{color:#9aa6b5;font-size:12px;padding-left:2px}
.ms-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:#e6f2fa;color:var(--navy);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;max-width:100%}
.ms-chip span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:150px}
.ms-chip b{cursor:pointer;opacity:.6}.ms-chip b:hover{opacity:1}
.ms-x{position:absolute;right:6px;top:8px;border:0;background:none;color:#9aa6b5;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}
.ms-dd{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(100% + 3px);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(10,30,60,.14);z-index:40;display:none;max-height:260px;overflow:auto}
.ms.open .ms-dd{display:block}
.ms-dd input.q{width:calc(100% - 12px);margin:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;font:inherit;font-size:12px}
.ms-opt{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.ms-opt:hover{background:#f2f7fb}
.ms-opt input{margin:0;accent-color:var(--cyan)}
.ms-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;bottom:0;background:#fff}
.ms-foot button{border:0;background:none;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px}
.legend{margin-top:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px;color:#556}
.legend summary{font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.legend p{margin:6px 0 0;line-height:1.45}
/* ===== MAIN ===== */
main{min-width:0;padding:0 0 60px}
.objtabs{display:flex;gap:2px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:0 16px;position:sticky;top:var(--shell);z-index:30;overflow-x:auto}
.objtabs .ot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;max-width:280px}
.objtabs .ot span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.objtabs .ot.on{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy)}
.objtabs .ot .x{border:0;background:none;color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;padding:0 2px;border-radius:4px}
.objtabs .ot .x:hover{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.screen{padding:16px 22px}
.pg-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:2px 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pg-h h1{margin:0;font-size:19px;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
.pg-h .sub{color:var(--mute);font-size:12px}
.pg-h .sp{flex:1}
.btn{font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid var(--navy);cursor:pointer;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.btn:hover{background:var(--navy2)}
.btn.ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border-color:#c8d3e1}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:#f2f7fb}
.btn.red{background:#fff;color:#c0392b;border-color:#f0b8b0}
.btn.sm{padding:6px 10px;font-size:11.5px}
.btn.cy{background:var(--cyan);border-color:var(--cyan)}
/* status tiles */
.pills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
@media(max-width:1300px){.pills{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.pill{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 8px 9px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(15,60,110,.05);border-bottom-width:3px}
.pill:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,60,110,.1)}
.pill.on{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:-1px}
.pill b{display:block;font-size:27px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.1}
.pill span{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--mute)}
.qualbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qualbar .lbl{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy)}
.bar{flex:1;min-width:220px;display:flex;height:12px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;gap:2px;background:var(--bg)}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.leg{display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;flex-wrap:wrap}
.leg span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;cursor:pointer}
.dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;flex:0 0 auto}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.chips .t{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase;margin-right:2px}
.chip{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:5px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--cyan)}
.chip.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.chip.dark.on{background:#374151;border-color:#374151}
.bulk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:9px 14px;background:#eaf5fa;border:1px solid #c4e3ef;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.bulk b{color:var(--navy)}
.bulk .g{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.bulk label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase}
.bulk select{font:inherit;font-size:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:5px 7px}
.tcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
.tbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tbar .count{font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);font-size:12px}
.tbar .sp{flex:1}
.scroll{overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 360px);min-height:260px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.3px}
thead th{position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;text-align:left;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:9px 9px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;z-index:2;user-select:none}
thead th .ar{opacity:.55;margin-left:3px}
tbody td{padding:8px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f5;white-space:nowrap;max-width:230px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
tbody tr:hover td{background:#f4f8fc}
tbody tr.late td{background:#fbe1e4}
tbody tr.today td{background:#fff3c4}
tbody tr.sel td{background:#e3f0fb}
td.nm b{color:var(--navy)}
.muted{color:var(--mute)}
.badge{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.tb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:4px}
.tb-Frio{background:#e3f2fd;color:#0F3C6E}.tb-Morno{background:#fff3cd;color:#7d5a00}.tb-Quente{background:#fce4ec;color:#9b1030}.tb-Perdido{background:#f1f1f1;color:#8a8a8a}.tb-Inativo{background:#f3e5f5;color:#6a4b8a}
.uf{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #d3ddec;background:#e8eef6;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;color:#3d5a80;margin-left:5px}
.porte{background:#efeafc;border-color:#d6cbef;color:#4b3b73}
.empty td{color:var(--mute);text-align:center;padding:26px;cursor:default}
/* ===== PAINEL LATERAL ===== */
.shade{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,30,60,.35);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;z-index:70}
.shade.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.panel{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100vh;width:min(560px,96vw);background:#fff;z-index:75;box-shadow:-8px 0 36px rgba(10,30,60,.22);transform:translateX(105%);transition:transform .25s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.panel.on{transform:none}
.p-h{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6f9fc,#fff);display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.p-h h2{margin:0;font-size:16px;color:var(--navy)}
.p-h .s{color:var(--mute);font-size:11.5px;margin-top:3px}
.p-h .bd{margin-top:8px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.p-x{margin-left:auto;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--bg);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;flex:0 0 auto}
.p-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:0 12px;overflow-x:auto}
.p-tab{padding:10px 13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap}
.p-tab.on{color:var(--cyan);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.p-b{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:16px 20px}
.p-sec{margin-bottom:18px}
.p-sec-t{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;margin-bottom:9px}
.ig{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:11px 14px}
.ig label{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:1px}
.ig span{font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;word-break:break-word}
.p-edit{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.tl-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
.tl-btn{padding:7px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;color:var(--navy)}
.tl-btn:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan)}
.locked{padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#f2f4f7;border:1px solid #d8dee6;color:#4a5568;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;margin-bottom:10px;width:100%}
.composer{background:#f6f9fc;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.composer h5{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--navy);font-size:13px}
.composer label{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase;margin:6px 0 3px}
.composer input,.composer select,.composer textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 9px;background:#fff}
.composer .row{display:flex;gap:8px}.composer .row>div{flex:1}
.composer .act{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.warn{margin-top:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:#fff7e6;border:1px solid #f0c36d;color:#7a4d00;font-size:11.5px}
.tl{position:relative;padding-left:22px}
.tl:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:6px;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:2px;background:var(--line)}
.tl-i{position:relative;margin-bottom:14px}
.tl-d{position:absolute;left:-22px;top:2px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px currentColor;background:currentColor}
.tl-h{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline}
.tl-h b{color:var(--navy);font-size:12.3px}
.tl-h small{color:var(--mute);font-size:10.5px}
.tl-h .au{margin-left:auto}
.tl-body{margin-top:4px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}
.stepper{display:flex;gap:3px;margin-bottom:6px}.stepper i{flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:2px;background:#e0e5ec}
.nextbox{border-radius:8px;padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.nextbox.late{background:#fdecea;border-color:#e89a92}.nextbox.soon{background:#fff7e6;border-color:#f0c36d}.nextbox.ok{background:#eaf5fb;border-color:#9fd3e4}
/* ===== REGISTRO (página do lead, padrão SAP) ===== */
.rec-h{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 22px 0}
.rec-top{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rec-ic{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:10px;background:#e6f2fa;color:var(--navy);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;flex:0 0 auto}
.rec-t h1{margin:0;font-size:19px;color:var(--navy)}
.rec-t .s{color:var(--mute);font-size:12px;margin-top:3px}
.rec-t .bd{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.rec-kv{display:flex;gap:26px;margin-left:auto;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rec-kv div{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute)}.rec-kv b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}
.rec-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rec-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:12px;overflow-x:auto}
.rec-tabs button{border:0;background:none;font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--mute);padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.rec-tabs button.on{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy)}
.rec-tabs .n{display:inline-block;min-width:18px;padding:1px 6px;margin-left:4px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--bg);font-size:10px}
.rec-b{padding:18px 22px;max-width:1180px}
.sec{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px}
.sec h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.7px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy)}
.sec p.d{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--mute);font-size:11.5px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px 18px}
@media(max-width:1000px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:640px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0}
.f.w2{grid-column:span 2}.f.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.f>label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#3b4b60}
.f>label .rq{color:var(--coral);margin-left:2px}
.f input,.f select,.f textarea{font:inherit;font-size:12.8px;border:1px solid #cfd8e3;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);width:100%}
.f input:focus,.f select:focus,.f textarea:focus{outline:2px solid #a8dcea;border-color:var(--cyan)}
.f input[readonly],.f input:disabled,.f select:disabled,.f textarea:disabled,.f textarea[readonly]{background:var(--ro);color:#4d5a6c;cursor:not-allowed}
.f textarea{min-height:64px;resize:vertical}
.f .hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute)}
.f.err input,.f.err select,.f.err .msel{border-color:var(--coral)!important;background:#fff5f3}
.row2{display:flex;gap:6px}.row2 input{min-width:0}
.dup{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:#fff7e6;border:1px solid #f0c36d;color:#7a4d00;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45}
.sug{padding:6px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:#eaf7f5;border:1px solid #bfe6df;color:#1f6e62;font-size:11px}
.msel{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;border:1px solid #cfd8e3;border-radius:7px;padding:6px;min-height:38px;background:#fff}
.msel label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--ink)}
.msel label:has(input:checked){background:#e6f2fa;border-color:#9fd0e6;color:var(--navy)}
.msel input{margin:0;accent-color:var(--cyan)}
.msel.dis{background:var(--ro);pointer-events:none;opacity:.85}
.fsteps{display:flex;gap:0;margin:4px 0 2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fsteps button{flex:1;min-width:110px;border:1px solid #cfd8e3;background:#fff;font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mute);padding:10px 8px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;margin-right:-1px}
.fsteps button:first-child{border-radius:8px 0 0 8px}.fsteps button:last-child{border-radius:0 8px 8px 0}
.fsteps button.done{background:#eaf7f5;color:#1f6e62}
.fsteps button.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy);z-index:1}
.fsteps button.lost.on{background:#c0392b;border-color:#c0392b}
.fsteps button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed}
.cnae{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--ro);font-size:12px;max-height:150px;overflow:auto}
.cnae li{margin:2px 0}
.upl{border:2px dashed #c8d3e1;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;background:#fafcfe}
.upl:hover{border-color:var(--cyan)}
.fi{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;background:#fff}
.fi a{margin-left:auto;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
.lockbar{margin:0 22px;margin-top:14px;padding:10px 14px;background:#fff4e5;border:1px solid #f3c88b;border-radius:8px;color:#7a4d00;font-size:12px}
.eye{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--navy)}
.eye.on{background:#fdecef;border-color:var(--coral);color:#b43a26}
/* ===== OPORTUNIDADES ===== */
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 10px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;border-bottom-width:3px;transition:.15s}
.kpi:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,60,110,.1)}
.kpi.on{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:-1px}
.kpi b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.15}
.kpi span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.kpi small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:3px}
.ind{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.ind div{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px}
.ind b{display:block;font-size:16px;color:var(--navy)}.ind span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mute);font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:1100px){.ind{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.kanban{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.kanban{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.col{background:#e7ecf3;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;min-height:240px}
.col.drop{outline:2px dashed var(--cyan)}
.col h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.col h3 small{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mute);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.oc{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:8px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06);font-size:12px;border-left:4px solid var(--navy);cursor:pointer}
.oc:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.oc b{display:block;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:3px}
.oc .v{font-weight:800;margin-top:6px}
.oc .ft{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.oc select{margin-top:8px;padding:5px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;width:100%}
.dl{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px}
.dl.late{background:#fdecea;color:#b43a26}.dl.soon{background:#fff3cd;color:#7d5a00}.dl.ok{background:#e6f2fa;color:var(--navy)}
/* ===== DASHBOARD ===== */
.selbar{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;min-height:30px}
.selbar .t{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase}
.selchip{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600}
.selchip b{cursor:pointer;opacity:.75}
.dkpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
@media(max-width:1300px){.dkpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.dk{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 8px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.dk:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,60,110,.1)}
.dk.on{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:-1px;background:#f2fafd}
.dk.static{cursor:default}
.dk b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.15}
.dk span{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.dgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
@media(max-width:1200px){.dgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:800px){.dgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dc{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;min-width:0}
.dc.w2{grid-column:span 2}.dc.w3{grid-column:1/-1}
@media(max-width:1200px){.dc.w2{grid-column:1/-1}}
.dc h4{margin:0 0 2px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy)}
.dc .ds{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--mute);font-size:11px}
.hb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,150px) 1fr 38px;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:7px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 4px;border-radius:6px}
.hb:hover{background:#f3f7fb}
.hb.dim{opacity:.35}
.hb.sel{background:#e6f2fa}
.hb span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.hb .tr{height:13px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}.hb .tr i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:6px}
.hb b{text-align:right}
.cv{position:relative}
/* termômetro (mesmo do atual) */
.thermo-modern{display:grid;grid-template-columns:125px 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:center;min-height:290px;padding:6px}
.tm-visual{height:260px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.tm-tube{position:relative;width:42px;height:205px;border:2px solid #c5d5e8;border-radius:24px 24px 18px 18px;background:#f0f4f9;box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);overflow:hidden;padding:5px}
.tm-liquid{position:absolute;left:5px;right:5px;bottom:5px;border-radius:16px;transition:height .55s ease;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#1A6BB5 0%,#3B82C4 28%,#E65100 62%,#A6192E 100%)}
.tm-glass{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent 45%,rgba(255,255,255,.04));pointer-events:none}
.tm-bulb{position:absolute;width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,22%);background:#f0f0f0;border:2px solid #bbb;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.tm-bulb::after{content:'';width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tm-color)}
.tm-marks{position:absolute;right:1px;top:30px;bottom:42px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;color:#6b7280;font-size:.62rem}
.tm-marks span::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:10px;height:1px;background:#c5d5e8;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle}
.tm-summary{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.tm-state{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid #dce8f2;padding-bottom:10px}
.tm-state .name{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}.tm-state .desc{font-size:.72rem;color:#6b7280}
.tm-stat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8f2;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer}
.tm-stat:hover{background:#f3f7fb}.tm-stat.sel{background:#e6f2fa;border-color:#9fd0e6}.tm-stat.dim{opacity:.4}
.tm-stat .lab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#4a5568;font-size:.8rem}
.tm-stat .lab .d{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%}
.tm-stat .val{font-size:1rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}.tm-stat .val small{font-size:.66rem;color:#6b7280;font-weight:500;margin-left:4px}
/* mapa (mesmo do atual) */
.br-map-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(190px,.6fr);gap:16px;align-items:stretch}
@media(max-width:900px){.br-map-shell{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.br-map-canvas{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:340px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0e6ee;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden}
.br-map-canvas svg{width:100%;height:340px;max-width:560px;overflow:visible}
.br-map-canvas path{transition:fill .2s ease,filter .2s ease;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1}
.br-map-canvas path:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);stroke:#0F3C6E!important;stroke-width:1.4!important}
.br-map-canvas path.sel{stroke:#EA6852!important;stroke-width:2.4!important}
.br-map-label{font-family:Montserrat,system-ui,sans-serif;fill:#0F3C6E;font-weight:800;text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.5px;stroke-linejoin:round}
.br-map-label-uf{font-size:15px}.br-map-label-v{font-size:19px}
.br-map-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.br-map-section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0e6ee;border-radius:12px;padding:11px}
.br-map-section h5{font-size:.66rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 7px}
.br-map-total{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}.br-map-total small{font-size:.7rem;color:#6b7280;font-weight:500;margin-left:5px}
.br-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;padding:5px 4px;font-size:.75rem;color:#1a2e44;border-radius:5px}
.br-row+.br-row{border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.br-row.ck{cursor:pointer}.br-row.ck:hover{background:#f3f7fb}.br-row.sel{background:#e6f2fa}
.br-row b{color:var(--navy)}
.mapleg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:8px}
.mapleg i{display:block;width:110px;height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d6eef5,#36B0C9,#0F3C6E)}
.legsec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:14px}
@media(max-width:900px){.legsec{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.legbox{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px}
.legbox h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.legit{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px}
.legit small{color:var(--mute)}
.legit .dot{border-radius:50%;transform:translateY(1px)}
/* ===== MODAIS ===== */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:90;background:rgba(10,30,60,.4);padding:20px}
.modal.on{display:flex}
.mbox{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;width:min(780px,100%);max-height:88vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.mh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.mh h3{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--navy)}
.mh button{border:0;background:var(--bg);width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}
.mb{padding:16px 18px;overflow:auto}
.mf{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#f8fafc;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px}
.atbl th{background:#f2f5f9;color:var(--navy);position:static}
.atbl td{white-space:normal}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:22px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;transition:.3s;z-index:120;max-width:90vw;text-align:center}
.toast.on{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.toast.err{background:#b43a26}.toast.ok{background:#1f6e62}
/* barra de demonstração */
.demo{position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:110;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(10,30,60,.18);padding:10px 12px;font-size:11.5px;width:250px}
.demo b{color:var(--navy);font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.demo .r{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
.demo label{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px}
.demo label:has(input:checked){background:#e6f2fa;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.demo input{accent-color:var(--cyan);margin:0}
.demo small{display:block;color:var(--mute);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4}
.demo .min{position:absolute;right:8px;top:6px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--mute)}
.demo.mini .r,.demo.mini small{display:none}

/* ===================== PADRÃO NEUTRO (SAP) COM AZUIS DELLAMED ===================== */
:root{--ink:#1d2d3e;--mute:#5b6b7c;--line:#e1e5ea;--bg:#f5f6f7;--ro:#f5f6f7;--frio:#a8cfe6;--morno:#36B0C9;--quente:#0F3C6E;--coral:#aa0808}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.side{border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav a{color:#32363a;font-weight:500}
.nav a.on{background:#eaf1f8;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
.nav a.on:before{background:var(--navy)}
.nav a .cnt{background:#eef0f2;color:#5b6b7c}
.fg>label,.side h4{color:#5b6b7c}
.btn-clear{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid #c9d2dc;font-weight:600}
.btn-clear:hover{background:#f2f5f8;filter:none}
.sh-badge{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.sh-btn.pri{border-radius:8px}
.ms-chip{background:#eef2f6;color:#1d2d3e}

/* ===== FONTE SAP 72 · cores só da Dellamed ===== */
body,button,input,select,textarea,.br-map-label{font-family:'72',Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif!important}
body{font-size:13.5px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
b,strong,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,th,.pill b,.kpi b,.dk b,.br-map-total,.tm-state .name,.tm-stat .val{font-weight:700!important}
.btn,.chip,.nav a.on,.sh-btn.pri{font-weight:600!important}
h1,.pg-h h1,.rec-t h1{font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:0}
.pill b,.kpi b,.dk b{letter-spacing:0!important}
.f>label,.fg>label,thead th,.side h4,.p-sec-t,.sec h3,.dc h4{letter-spacing:.2px!important}
/* painel lateral neutro */
.p-h{background:#fff!important}
.p-h h2{color:#1d2d3e}
.p-tab{color:#5b6b7c;font-weight:500}
.p-tab.on{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
.p-sec-t{color:#5b6b7c}
.ig span{font-weight:500;color:#1d2d3e}
.p-links{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:2px 0 16px}
.golink{color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.golink span{transition:transform .15s}
.golink:hover span{transform:translateX(3px)}
.golink:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.golink.muted2{color:#5b6b7c}
.p-kv{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.p-kv span{color:#5b6b7c;font-size:12px}.p-kv b{color:#1d2d3e}.p-kv small{color:#5b6b7c;margin-left:auto}
.tl-d{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px currentColor;width:12px;height:12px;left:-21px;top:3px}
.tl-h b{color:#1d2d3e;font-weight:600!important}
.tl-body{background:#fff;color:#1d2d3e}
.rec-foot{position:fixed!important;left:var(--side);right:0;bottom:0}
.app.collapsed .rec-foot{left:0}
.rec-b{padding-bottom:90px!important}
.stepper i{border-radius:3px}
/* rodapé do cadastro (Salvar / Cancelar embaixo, padrão SAP) */
.rec-foot{position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 22px;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 -2px 8px rgba(29,45,62,.06)}
.rec-actions .btn.ghost{font-weight:600!important}

.seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid #b9c4d0;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin-right:8px}
.seg button{border:0;background:#fff;padding:7px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#32363a;cursor:pointer}
.seg button+button{border-left:1px solid #b9c4d0}
.seg button.on{background:#0F3C6E;color:#fff}
.cal .tbar{gap:6px}
.cal-t{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0F3C6E;margin-left:8px}
.cal-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.cal-w{padding:7px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#6a7580;background:#f8fafc;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cal-d{min-height:104px;padding:5px 6px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden}
.cal-d:nth-child(7n){border-right:0}
.cal-d:hover{background:#f5f8fb}
.cal-d.out{background:#fafbfc}.cal-d.out .cal-n{color:#b0b8c1}
.cal-n{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#32363a;margin-bottom:3px}
.cal-d.today .cal-n{display:inline-block;background:#0F3C6E;color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:0 7px}
.cal-e{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.35;padding:2px 5px;margin-bottom:2px;border-radius:4px;background:#eef2f6;color:#32363a;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.cal-e:hover{background:#dfe7ef}
.cal-e i{flex:none;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%}
.cal-e.done{color:#8a939c;text-decoration:line-through;background:#f4f6f8}
.cal-more{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#0F3C6E;padding:1px 5px}
.dl-i{display:grid;grid-template-columns:14px 48px 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
.dl-i:hover{background:#f5f8fb}.dl-i em{font-style:normal;font-size:11.5px;color:#6a7580}
.mf .sp{flex:1}
.cf-box{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;background:#f8fafc;font-size:13px}
#remBox{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:78px;width:340px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);z-index:85;display:none;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c9d2dc;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(15,60,110,.22);max-height:70vh;overflow:auto}
#remBox.on{display:block;animation:remIn .25s ease}
@keyframes remIn{from{transform:translateY(12px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.rem-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 14px;background:#0F3C6E;color:#fff;font-size:13px;position:sticky;top:0}
.rem-h .lnk{color:#fff}
.rem-i{padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.rem-i:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.rem-w{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#36B0C9}
.rem-t{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:#32363a;margin:3px 0 2px}
.rem-s{font-size:12px}
.rem-a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}
.rem-a .sp{flex:1}
.rem-snz{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.rem-snz select,.rem-snz input{flex:1;min-width:0;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid #b9c4d0;border-radius:6px}
.lnk{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#0F3C6E;cursor:pointer}
.lnk:hover{text-decoration:underline}
@media(max-width:760px){.cal-d{min-height:64px}.cal-e b,.cal-e{font-size:10px}}
.rem-n{padding:8px 14px;background:#f2f7fb;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.lk{position:relative}
.lk-l{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;margin-top:2px;z-index:5;background:#fff;border:1px solid #b9c4d0;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(15,60,110,.16);max-height:260px;overflow:auto}
.lk-i{padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f4;font-size:12.5px}
.lk-i:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.lk-i b{display:block;font-weight:600;color:#32363a}
.lk-i small{color:#6a7580;font-size:11.5px}
.lk-i:hover,.lk-i.on{background:#eef4fa}
.lk-v{padding:10px;color:#6a7580;font-size:12.5px}
tr.log td{color:#6a7580}
.rpt-tag{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;color:#fff;font-size:13px;line-height:1.25}.rpt-tag small{opacity:.8;font-size:11.5px}

.ico-exp{display:inline-block;vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:6px;color:#32363a;opacity:.75}
[data-k="Razão Social"]{text-transform:uppercase}

.is-busy{cursor:progress}.is-busy #view,.is-busy .panel,.is-busy .mbox{pointer-events:none;opacity:.8}
.dd-i{cursor:default}
/* Oportunidades com 5 fases */
.kpis.k5{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}
.kanban.k5{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media(max-width:1300px){.kanban.k5{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:1100px){.kanban.k5{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.kpis.k5{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:768px){.kpis.k5{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
/* barra de progresso do Salvar */
#saveProg{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:110;display:none;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe3ec;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 16px 11px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,47,99,.16);width:220px;pointer-events:none}
#saveProg.on{display:block;animation:spIn .15s ease}
@keyframes spIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}}
@keyframes spRot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#saveProg .sp-t{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#002F63;margin-bottom:7px;letter-spacing:.2px}
#saveProg .sp-bar{height:5px;background:#e8eef4;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
#saveProg .sp-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0D4A8A,#36B0C9);border-radius:99px;transition:width .15s linear}
#saveProg.ok .sp-t{color:#256f3a}#saveProg.ok .sp-bar i{background:#256f3a}
/* campos que só valem para CNPJ do Brasil (Time Exportação) */
.f .na{border:1px dashed #f0b4ae;background:#fdf1f0;color:#c0392b;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;letter-spacing:.5px}

<header class="shell">
  <button class="sh-menu" id="btnSide" title="Mostrar/ocultar menu"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/></svg></button>
  <img class="sh-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Dellamed">
  <div class="sh-search"><div class="box"><input id="gSearch" placeholder="Pesquisar lead, CNPJ, cidade, UF, contato..."><span class="ic"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg></span></div></div>
  <div class="sh-actions" id="shActions"></div>
</header>

<div class="app" id="app">
  <aside class="side" id="side">
    <h4>Menu</h4>
    <nav class="nav" id="nav">
      <a href="#" data-go="dash">Dashboard</a>
      <a href="#" data-go="leads">Leads<span class="cnt" id="cntLeads"></span></a>
      <a href="#" data-go="opp">Oportunidades<span class="cnt" id="cntOpp"></span></a>
      <a href="#" data-go="atv">Atividades<span class="cnt" id="cntAtv"></span></a>
          </nav>
    <div class="flt" id="fltBox"></div>
    <details class="legend">
      <summary>O que significa cada indicador</summary>
      <p><b>Qualificado</b> — antigo "Contato feito": já houve conversa.</p>
      <p><b>Proposta enviada / Negociando</b> — contados pela data em que o lead mudou para o status.</p>
      <p><b>Convertido</b> — antigo "Ganho": fechou pedido (nº e valor total).</p>
      <p><b>Perdido</b> — desistiu ou escolheu concorrente.</p>
      <p><b>Inativo</b> — automático: 30 dias sem interação (90 para LOJ. Licitação).</p>
      <p><b>Taxa de conversão</b> — convertidos ÷ total de leads.</p>
      <p><b>Ticket médio</b> — valor médio por lead no período.</p>
      <p><b>Forecast</b> — pipeline ponderado pela etapa.</p>
    </details>
  </aside>
  <main id="main">
    <div class="objtabs" id="objtabs"></div>
    <div id="view"></div>
  </main>
</div>

<!-- painel lateral do lead -->
<div class="shade" id="shade"></div>
<div class="panel" id="panel">
  <div class="p-h"><div style="min-width:0"><h2 id="pTitle"></h2><div class="s" id="pSub"></div><div class="bd" id="pBadges"></div></div><button class="p-x" onclick="closePanel()">✕</button></div>
  <div class="p-tabs" id="pTabs"></div>
  <div class="p-b" id="pBody"></div>
</div>

<!-- modal genérico -->
<div class="modal" id="modal"><div class="mbox" id="mbox"></div></div>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>


</div>
